content:textarea:6:57.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:6:57.html: Holidays can be very lonely times for vulnerable adults who have no family support. The Salvation Army is here to give hope to seniors struggling during this time. We provide Christmas gifts, coats and shoes to vulnerable adults through partnerships with local county agencies who identify those needs.
